items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: I joined Fletcher... Naturally, Fletcher was on piano and we had a fellow named Pete Suggs on drums... Then we played the Grand Terrace in Chicago.

ctx.x: That was 1930. And then we -- in fact, when I was in Chicago we got married in Chicago. Then while I'm in California, about a year before Fletcher came out there, she and I broke up and she went back to Minneapolis. Then I was single at this time when I joined Fletcher.
That house you had been renting --
